prose:
Scientific American reports that Tristan Buckmaster and Levent Alpöge claim a new AI-aided Navier-Stokes blowup result that addresses a disputed feature of an earlier OpenAI result. The article says the rushed write-up did not yet include the promised certificate.

This is reporting on a proposed mathematical result, not independent validation or confirmation of a prize award. The description of a loophole is part of the reported controversy, and allegations concerning earlier use of researcher data remain disputed. Neither the proof nor its assumptions and certificate were audited here.
highlights: Article reports a newly claimed result
Earlier forcing conditions are part of the dispute
Promised certificate was not included in this account
Proof and assumptions were not independently checked
Misconduct allegation and denial must remain distinct
